connector.name: Qiskit Code Assistant MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Qiskit Code Assistant intelligent code completion
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package qiskit-code-assistant-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the qiskit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
